title: Digital Tube Inflation System - Airojet1000HMV C
description: Automatic inflator for tube inflation with vacuum pressure.
subtitle: Digital Tube Inflation System
fullDescription: Automatic inflator for tube inflation with vacuum pressure. Features two digital readouts, LCD display with back light, tower lamp with buzzer for process and end of cycle indication, separate start and stop keys for user safety, and can customize the value within 6 to 1000 mmH2O.
features: Two digital readouts one for set pressure and other for tube pressure
LCD display with back light to provide good visibility
Display remain at same set pressure value even at power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
Tower lamp with buzzer for process and end of cycle indication
Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or vacuum tyre
25/35 key for easy tube pressure setting, can customized the value within 6 to 1000 mmH2O
Inflates the tube with vacuum pressure
Separate start and stop keys for user safety
Pressure regulator with pressure gauge for input air pressure setting

specifications.inputAirHose: 10mm x 10mtrs PU Hose with suitable fittings
specifications.inputFilter: 1/2 x 5 micron air filter with regulator suitable fittings
specifications.outputAirHose: 10mm x 10mtrs PU Hose with clip-on connector
specifications.workingPressureRange: 0 to 1000 water column (mm H2O) - working even at vacuum pressure
specifications.keypad: Membrane Keypad suitable for outdoor application
specifications.display: 4 Digit 7 Segment LCD with Automatic LED backlight ON & OFF
specifications.dimensions: Dimension varies depends on customer requirement
specifications.note: External storage tank is must and size may vary depends upon customer requirement
